expectations.text: The response restates the deck's job as verbs or an effect on its audience rather than as 'a deck'
expectations.evidence: “我把它讲成一条主线（增长减速 → 流失翻倍 → 体验先崩）……这样 VP 能记住一个结论。” This explicitly identifies the intended audience effect.

expectations.text: The response suggests borrowing from other fields (a crew), including at least one adversarial or red-team role
expectations.evidence: “主动暴露了 4 个口径缺口……放在附录防守” anticipates scrutiny, but no borrowed fields, crew, or adversarial role are proposed.

expectations.text: The response describes what each field would do, not how it would write or sound
expectations.evidence: “下季计划 — 3 条工作流 + 需 VP 决策的 3 项” describes business plans; no borrowed fields are identified or assigned concrete tasks.
